tiles.title: Designing: Connecting your prosthesis to a servo

text:
Did you think about how the servo is similar to a part of a biological hand or arm? If not, think about it as you work on your design.

Right now, you are designing how to connect your prosthesis to a servo to make it move.

You need to design two parts:

The hardware: How will your prosthesis actually connect to the servo?

The software: Do you need to make any modifications from the Dataflow program you made in Lesson 1.3 to make it work?

How will you actually connect your prosthesis to the servo?

Sketch your idea. Make sure to include what materials you need -- and make sure they are materials you actually have in your classroom! If you're not sure, check with your teacher!

tiles.title: How will you connect your prosthesis to the servo?
Most things don't work perfectly on the first try. What problems do you anticipate, and how will you solve them?

text: Use the Class Portfolio to look at your program from Lesson 1.3 and answer the two questions below!
